diagnosis: The view queries ServerHostNode by host_id using extra(select={...}) without checking that the host node belongs to request.user.tenant. An authenticated user can inspect server host names and compute resource allocation metrics of dedicated bare-metal servers belonging to other customers.
exploit_request:
GET /api/infrastructure/hosts/4102/metrics/ HTTP/1.1
Host: monitor.cloudhost.net
Authorization: Bearer <customer_b_token>
